WITH monthly_order_payments AS (
    SELECT
        op.order_id,
        ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS order_payment_amount
    FROM order_payments AS op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
),
monthly_order_item_totals AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        ABS(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)) AS order_item_total_amount
    FROM order_items AS oi
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
monthly_order_item_alloc AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))) AS month,
        COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category,
        ABS(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)) AS category_item_amount
    FROM order_items AS oi
    INNER JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    LEFT JOIN products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_translation AS pct
        ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '11 months'
      AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month'
    GROUP BY
        oi.order_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))),
        COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
)
SELECT
    moia.month AS month,
    moia.product_category AS product_category,
    ABS(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN moit.order_item_total_amount > 0 THEN mop.order_payment_amount * (moia.category_item_amount / moit.order_item_total_amount)
            ELSE 0
        END
    )) AS total_sales_amount
FROM monthly_order_item_alloc AS moia
INNER JOIN monthly_order_payments AS mop
    ON mop.order_id = moia.order_id
INNER JOIN monthly_order_item_totals AS moit
    ON moit.order_id = moia.order_id
GROUP BY
    moia.month,
    moia.product_category
ORDER BY
    moia.month,
    moia.product_category;
